answer: Delay-proof renewal: each epoch the network emits a random pulse, and every agent must return a sequential delay proof seeded by that pulse and its own key. The math moves at glacier speed, about 5 hours on one core, and cannot be split across machines or reused by a sibling key. Passing earns an opal badge valid for one epoch only. So 1 identity costs 1 dedicated core; 200 fakes need 200 cores running nonstop, roughly $9,600 a month, forever.
